subject.title: [Feature]: REST endpoint for session management in HTTP API integrations

question: Should OpenClaw expose dedicated `/v1/sessions/*` REST session-management endpoints for HTTP integrations, or steer integrations to the default-off admin HTTP RPC/plugin/WebSocket surfaces instead?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but adding reset, compact, model, and reasoning controls to the OpenAI-compatible HTTP API expands a public control-plane surface and needs maintainer product/security direction.

options.title: Approve dedicated REST session management
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated Gateway HTTP layer over existing session handlers for reset, status, compact, model, and reasoning with explicit operator-scope, reserved-key, rate-limit, docs, and tests coverage.

options.title: Use admin HTTP RPC instead
options.body: Document and, if needed, adjust the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin as the intended HTTP control-plane path for trusted integrations instead of adding `/v1/sessions/*`.

options.title: Defer mutating HTTP controls
options.body: Keep HTTP integrations on chat completions plus WebSocket/plugin surfaces until maintainers are ready to own a broader REST control-plane contract.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated REST session management
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated Gateway HTTP layer over existing session handlers for reset, status, compact, model, and reasoning with explicit operator-scope, reserved-key, rate-limit, docs, and tests coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available owner because he authored the original OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint and already scoped this issue as a product/security decision.
